findings.claim: spec-11 (change-repos-routines-ui.md) Tests table requires `internal/server/routines_test.go TestRoutineDetailRunHistory (extend)` asserting the run-history row carries `data-stamp="..."` and the rendered body includes the run-band grouping script, but no such test file or test exists anywhere in internal/server — the week-band template/JS feature (DR4, routine_detail.html Phase 4) ships with zero server-side coverage.
findings.evidence: Read every file in the lane manifest's `files` list for internal/server: there is no `internal/server/routines_test.go` (the whole package test set is bootstrap_test.go, config_sync_test.go, overview_test.go, presentation_test.go, profilesettings_test.go, proposals_test.go, repos_test.go, server_test.go, sessions_test.go, skills_analytics_test.go, statuscache_test.go, welcome_test.go — none exercises handleRoutineDetail/handleRoutinesIndex/routineView at all). routines.go (diff +39) and templates/routine_detail.html (diff, Phase 4 week-bands) carry the DR4 week-band change; grep of the full assigned file set for `data-stamp` and `run-band` shows only the template markup and inline script, never a Go test assertion. findings.fix: Add a test (e.g. in a new internal/server/routines_test.go) that GETs /routines/{name} against a routine with multi-week run history and asserts the rendered body contains `data-stamp="<RFC3339>"` and the run-band script marker, per spec-11's Tests table.

findings.claim: spec-14 (change-repo-cache.md) Tests table requires `internal/server/repos_test.go TestReposDelete (updated): unchanged + repo stays deleted after a second registry instance (fresh NewRegistry on same path) writes — cross-instance regression`, but TestReposDelete only has the three pre-existing subtests (removes-and-persists, unknown-name-renders-failure, empty-name-is-bad-request) — no subtest constructs a second `repos.NewRegistry` on the same `repos.json` path to verify the delete survives a concurrent/second reader, which is exactly the stale-registry-state defect (Cause 1) spec-14 sets out to fix.
findings.evidence: Re-read internal/server/repos_test.go lines 689-720 (TestReposDelete) in full: three t.Run blocks, none opening a second registry instance or asserting cross-instance persistence. Cross-checked the rest of repos_test.go for any `NewRegistry` call outside server construction — none found. The production fix this test is meant to pin (registry reload-per-request / fresh-read semantics) lives in internal/repos (a sibling chunk), but the test itself is explicitly spec'd to live in this file.
findings.fix: Add a TestReposDelete subtest that deletes a repo through the server, then opens a fresh `repos.NewRegistry(reposPath)` + `Reload()` and asserts the deleted repo is absent — pinning the cross-instance regression spec-14 names.
